title: Rent receipt input
description: One receipt per month, laid out three to an A4 page. Every field is optional except the ones a receipt needs; files passed to the CLI merge left to right (landlord file, tenant file, the months).

landlordName.description: Name of the person or firm receiving the rent

landlordPan.description: Landlord's PAN; required when the rent for the year is above the threshold in rules/hra-rent.json, and format-checked

tenantName.description: Tenant's name, as it should appear in the HRA claim

propertyAddress.description: Address of the rented premises, lines separated by \n

months.description: Months to make receipts for, each as YYYY-MM; one receipt per month

from.description: First month of a range, YYYY-MM; used when months is empty

to.description: Last month of a range, YYYY-MM; used when months is empty

paymentMode.description: How the rent was paid, e.g. Cash, UPI, NEFT, cheque; a cash receipt shows a revenue stamp box

paymentRef.description: Payment reference: UPI/NEFT reference (UTR) or cheque number

place.description: Place where the landlord signs, e.g. Bengaluru

notes.description: Free text printed at the foot of every receipt

signName.description: Name under the signature; defaults to the landlord's name

stampRequired.description: Whether the receipt needs a revenue stamp; set by the tool from rules/hra-rent.json
